title: PHP · Rollout only
subtitle: A fleet notice has no site or runtime binding.
evidence:
[S0] Public CVE metadata | PHP CNA | CVE-2026-109618
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/main/cves/2026/109xxx/CVE-2026-109618.json
PUBLISHED; format 5.2; updated 2026-10-23T14:07:55.926Z. Upstream PHP 8.5.* before 8.5.12 is affected. This identifies a vulnerability, not the patch state of a website.

[S1] Public Hostinger status | 2026-10-22T06:44:00Z
Source: https://statuspage.hostinger.com/incidents/pj2zs1lx3n9d
Managed-hosting PHP rollout completed. Customer VPS is outside that rollout.

[S2] SYNTHETIC REVIEW FILE | 2026-10-24T09:00:00Z
asset: demo-shop.example (invented example domain)
The file contains the public rollout notice only. Hosting tier, asset inventory, site PHP Info and serving-runtime build date are absent.
humanNote: Invented site. The public notice alone cannot bind the asset to a covered plan or demonstrate its serving PHP build; missing proof is not proof of compromise.
policy: Assess only closure of the CVE-2026-109618 alert for the named synthetic website at the stated review snapshot. Accept closure only when evidence binds that exact asset to its hosting platform/tier, an applicable remediation, and a current observation of the PHP runtime serving that website that meets the provider verification guidance. A general rollout announcement, CLI version, or WAF statement alone is not site-specific patch proof. An old displayed version can still qualify when an applicable backport is demonstrated by the provider-prescribed serving-runtime check. If asset, tier or runtime proof is missing, the closure claim is unproven; do not infer vulnerability or compromise from missing evidence. Other CVEs and general PHP safety are outside this policy.
claim: At the synthetic 2026-10-24T09:00:00Z review snapshot, the supplied records establish that the PHP runtime serving demo-shop.example meets the applicable remediation evidence requirement to close its CVE-2026-109618 alert.
